subject: Roadmap demo slate consolidation + rollcall
messages:
From: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: BDR Team <bdr@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Roadmap demo slate consolidation + rollcall

Hi Sean / Marissa —

Thanks again for the QBR prep call last week. We wanted to see if Redwood can consolidate the three shorter roadmap demos we have on Oct 25–27 into a single, tighter slate. Goal: reduce exec context switching and make it easier for our product leads to attend.

Would your team be able to run a consolidated slate on the morning of Friday, Oct 22 (90–120 minutes) or, alternatively, Saturday Oct 23 morning (we can make exceptions for execs if needed)? We know weekend asks are awkward so happy to accept a split into two 50-minute blocks with a 10-minute buffer.

Key asks from our side:
- 30 minutes for exec-level overview up front (presence preferred)
- one live technical deep-dive (30–40m) for infra/ops folks
- clear Q&A + next steps and a short mutual action plan

Attaching a short priority list (see inline below). Can you confirm availability and preferred format?

Thanks — Clara

--
Clara Nguyen
Director, Platform Partnerships
Brightline Health

Attachment: brightline-priorities.pdf (see stubs)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap demo slate consolidation + rollcall

Clara — thanks for the clear asks. Appreciate the flexibility on windows. Replying quickly after syncing with the ops team.

Short answer: we can do a consolidated slate. Two options that we recommend:
1) One 110-minute block (09:00–10:50 PT) with the structure you listed (30m exec, 40m tech, 25m Q&A/action)
2) Split: two 50-minute slots (09:00–09:50, 10:00–10:50 PT) with a 10-minute buffer — better for execs who can only make the first half.

Operational notes / constraints:
- Marissa can host/stage both slots; Monica can own the technical deep-dive for infra.
- Karthik is on call for any regional compliance questions and can join earlier if needed.
- We try to avoid Saturday for exec-heavy asks; Friday (Oct 22) is preferable for us.

I'm attaching a proposed agenda and a skeletal mutual action plan (MAP). If Friday works for you, we'll send calendar invites and a recording preference poll.

Would you prefer we block Friday 09:00–10:50 PT as one slate, or do you want the split approach? Once you confirm we will:
- lock invites (including a separate exec pre-brief 15m earlier)
- share the MAP for signatures/action owners

Thanks — Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE, Renewal & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-proposed-agenda.pdf; mutual-action-plan.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap demo slate consolidation + rollcall

Clara / team — I can cover both hosting duties. A couple quick asks from our side to keep the slate tight:
- Can Brightline provide the top 3 customer use cases you want emphasized (so we tune the live demo)?
- Please indicate if recordings are allowed for internal redistribution — that changes how we structure the exec piece.

Operational preference: split blocks (2x50) usually yield higher attendance across execs. If you want exec presence for the first 30m, we can do: 08:45 PT exec pre-brief (15m), 09:00–09:50 slot, 10:00–10:50 slot. I'll manage the buffer and transitions.

Happy to iterate on the agenda — Sean, can you make the small timing tweaks in the PDF before we send invites?

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Success Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@brightlinehealth.com>

Thanks Marissa — split blocks sound perfect. Confirming:
- Brightline execs will attend the first 30 minutes of the 09:00 slot (we can be flexible on exact people).
- Use cases for emphasis: 1) multi-tenant inference for partner networks, 2) data residency controls for EU subs, 3) cost/performance for burst workloads.
- Recording allowed internally — but please lock access to our org.

We prefer Friday, Oct 22. Please go ahead and send the invites for the two slots (09:00–09:50 PT, 10:00–10:50 PT) plus a 15-minute exec pre-brief at 08:45 PT. Also include the MAP in the invite and mark action owners.

Great — thanks for confirming, Clara. Final plan below and next steps: 

Schedule (Friday, Oct 22, PT):
- 08:45–09:00 PT: Exec pre-brief (Sean + Clara + Brightline execs) — invite sent as "optional" for execs
- 09:00–09:50 PT: Slot 1 (exec overview + first demo) — Marissa host
- 10:00–10:50 PT: Slot 2 (technical deep-dive + Q&A) — Monica host

Actions we completed: 
- Calendar invites sent to attendees (Google Calendar links in the invite).
- MAP uploaded and attached to invites (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) — please review action owners directly in the doc.
- Recording will be enabled and access limited to Brightline domain — recording retention set to 30 days per your preference.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8347-9832 (deal); https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=roadmap-demo-consolidation (master invite)
